public_context: Mina is a technical writer who has recently missed several deadlines and feels her current job may no longer suit her. She is considering leaving her salaried position to freelance.
initial_request: Should I resign this month and become a freelance technical writer?

ground_truth.expected_problem_formulation: The decision is whether Mina's difficulties reflect remediable work fragmentation or a lasting mismatch with salaried technical writing, and whether freelancing would improve her performance under acceptable financial risk.
ground_truth.problem_formulation_rationale: Failures began only after fragmented assignments, but no workload or interruption records separate remediable work design from a durable fit problem, and the unrepresentative freelance sample cannot establish that freelancing would help; therefore, answering whether to resign treats an untested remedy as the problem.
ground_truth.expected_resolution: Do not resign this month. Because the cause of the missed deadlines and the suitability of freelancing remain undetermined, first run the manager's protected-work trial and a small realistic freelance pilot while employed, then decide.
ground_truth.resolution_rationale: Current records and the self-selected unpaid sample cannot resolve whether the problem is remediable fragmentation or a lasting mismatch, nor whether freelancing would help; with only about two months of savings, no contracted clients, and no forced deadline to leave, quitting before those tests would invent certainty the evidence does not support.

hidden_facts.content: Mina met deadlines consistently until three months ago, when she was reassigned from one main project to four projects with frequent priority changes.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about when the deadline problems began or how their pattern relates to changes in Mina's assignments.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks only how many deadlines Mina missed or whether her overall performance declined.

hidden_facts.content: Mina has not tracked planned versus actual task time or interruptions, so the available records cannot distinguish overload, context switching, inaccurate estimates, or reduced interest.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about evidence identifying the causes of delays or what information Mina currently records about her work.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks only which productivity tools Mina uses or requests all potentially relevant information.

hidden_facts.content: Her manager has offered a four-week trial with one primary project, protected focus periods, and weekly review of estimates, interruptions, delivery, and energy.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks whether Mina can test a different work arrangement or whether her manager has offered changes before she leaves.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks only about general workplace flexibility or whether Mina likes her manager.

hidden_facts.content: Mina has savings for about two months of essential expenses, and none of her three informal freelance leads has committed to paid work.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about Mina's financial buffer, expected freelance income, or whether prospective clients have made commitments.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks only whether freelancers can earn more or what salary Mina would prefer.

hidden_facts.content: Mina has received no formal warning, and her manager says she can take at least six weeks to evaluate options without an employment decision.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks about the urgency of the decision, employment consequences, or how long Mina can safely wait.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks only whether Mina personally feels pressure to decide quickly.

hidden_facts.content: Mina enjoyed one unpaid freelance sample, but she chose the topic and deadline herself and received no client revisions or competing requests.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks what direct experience Mina has with freelancing or how representative her freelance test was.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks only whether Mina likes the idea of freelancing or values independence.

hidden_facts.content: Her employment policy permits a disclosed outside project of up to five hours weekly, allowing a small paid assignment before resignation.
hidden_facts.reveal_if: The question asks whether Mina can realistically test paid freelance work while retaining her current job.
hidden_facts.do_not_reveal_if: The question explicitly asks only whether outside employment is generally common or whether Mina has spare time.
